project.name: ${project.groupId}:${project.artifactId}
project.description: The Java functions the fact store's SQL calls, bound by CREATE ALIAS in graphitron-model's DDL. Its own module because graphitron-model's jOOQ codegen runs the DDL in generate-sources, before the model's own classes are compiled, so a function the DDL binds has to be on the codegen plugin's classpath as a dependency. graphitron-model depends on it at run time too, where the store and the rejection messages call the same function.
